Rashi on Nedarim 30a:1:1.hebrew: תפשוט דבעי רב הושעיא וכו' ה"נ דהוו קידושי - דכי היכי דהתם אמר לה לאחר שאגרשיך, שיצתה מרשותו, שתתקדש — הייני דומיא לאחר שנקצצו, שיוצאין מרשות הקדש, דמצריך להו פדייה:
Rashi on Nedarim 30a:1:1.english: Resolve [the dilemma], as Rav Hoshaya asked, etc., so too it should be [a valid] betrothal - For just as there he said to her "after I divorce you" — [meaning] once she has left his domain — that she should become betrothed, this is similar to "after they are cut down," when they leave the domain of consecrated property, where [Bar Padda] requires redemption for them.

Rashi on Nedarim 30a:2:1.hebrew: פדאן הוא - המקדיש קודם שנקצצו, חוזרות וקדושות לאחר שנקצצו, דהואיל והוא הקדישן, אע"ג דחזר ופדאן, חוזרות וקדושות לאחר שנקצצו:
Rashi on Nedarim 30a:2:1.english: He redeemed them - [That is, if] the one who consecrated [them redeemed them] before they were cut, they become consecrated again after they are cut; for since he is the one who consecrated them, even though he subsequently redeemed them, they become consecrated again after they are cut.

Rashi on Nedarim 30a:2:2.hebrew: פדאום אחרים - קודם שנקצצו, אין חוזרות וקדושות לאחר שנקצצו. ואשה שקנתה עצמה בגט מדעת עצמה, אין חלין עליה קדושין, דכפדאוה אחרים דמיא; דאין חוזרות וקדושו', לגבי אשה נמי אינה מקודשת:
Rashi on Nedarim 30a:2:2.english: Others redeemed them - Before they were cut down, they do not become consecrated again after they are cut down. And a woman who acquired herself through a bill of divorce [is] under her own authority, [so] betrothal does not take effect upon her [without her consent], for she is considered as if others redeemed her; for [just as] they do not become consecrated again, regarding a woman as well she is not betrothed.

Rashi on Nedarim 30a:4:1.hebrew: הנודר - שלא יהנה מיורדי הים, מותר ליהנות מיושבי היבשה. והנודר מליהנות מיושבי היבשה, אסור ליהנות מיורדי הים, שהן נמי מיושבי היבשה הן, שסופן לצאת. ומה שאמר "יורדי הים בכלל יושבי היבשה" — לא כאלו יורדי הים ההולכים מעכו ליפו, שאין ביניהם אלא מהלך יום אחד ובאין מהרה ליבשה, דהוו בכלל יושבי היבשה:
Rashi on Nedarim 30a:4:1.english: One who takes a vow - That he will not derive benefit from seafarers is permitted to derive benefit from those who live on dry land. And one who takes a vow not to derive benefit from those who live on dry land is prohibited from deriving benefit from seafarers, for they too are among those who live on dry land, since they will eventually disembark [onto dry land]. And [as for] that which [the Mishnah] said, "seafarers are included among those who live on dry land" — [this does] not [refer to] those seafarers who travel from Akko to Jaffa, for between them is only a journey of one day and they come quickly to dry land, so that they are included among those who live on dry land.

Rashi on Nedarim 30a:5:1.hebrew: חד מתני ארישא - לא כאלו וכו', ולא כאלו יורדי הים אסור:
Rashi on Nedarim 30a:5:1.english: One teaches [it] with regard to the first clause - [That is,] "Not like those [who travel from Akko to Jaffa]," etc.; [meaning,] not like those [are considered] seafarers [who are] prohibited.

Tosafot on Nedarim 30a:2:1.hebrew: פדאן אחרים אין חוזרות וקדושו' - שהרי פדאן לעצמו, והרי שם דאין אדם מקדיש דבר שאינו שלו. אשה נמי כי אחרים, שקונה עצמה בגט, דאין בידו לקדשה עוד בעל כרחה אלא מדעתה. והלכך אימא תיבעי: מי אמרינן כיון דאי אפשר לו לקדש בע"כ, לפדיון אחרים דמיא ולא מצי מקדיש לה; או דלמא השתא מיהא מצי מקדיש לה אדעתה, וכיון דכהאי גוונא מצי לקדש לה לאחר שיגרשנה, השתא נמי יקדשנה — לפדאן הוא דמיא; הלכך תיבעי:
Tosafot on Nedarim 30a:2:1.english: [If] others redeemed them, they do not become consecrated again - for [the other person] redeemed them for himself, and behold there [applies the principle] that a person cannot consecrate something that is not his. A woman too is like others, for she acquires herself through a bill of divorce, as it is not in his power to betroth her again against her will, but only with her consent. Therefore, say [that Rav Hoshaya's question remains] a dilemma: Do we say that since it is impossible for him to betroth [her] against her will, it is comparable to redemption by others and he cannot betroth her [in advance]; or perhaps, now at least he can betroth her with her consent, and since in this manner he can betroth her after he divorces her, now too he can betroth her — [so] it is comparable to [a case where] he redeemed them [himself]; therefore, let it remain an unresolved dilemma.

Tosafot on Nedarim 30a:4:1.hebrew: הנודר מיורדי הים מותר ביושבי היבשה - שאין עומדין על שפת הים, דאין רגילין לעבור בים. ומיהו אדם העובר פעם אחת לזמן מרובה, ואינו רגיל לעבור שם, לא מיקרי יורדי הים, והנודר מיורדי הים מותר בו. ואפי' למ"ד בגמ' דאותם שהולכים מעכו ליפו מיקרו יורדי הים — התם, נהי דאין שוהין בה, מ"מ רגילין לעבור תדיר לעבור בים נינהו; אבל זה העובר פעם אחת לעשרה שנים לא מיקרי יורדי הים כלל, דבנדרים הלך אחר לשון בני אדם:
Tosafot on Nedarim 30a:4:1.english: "One who takes a vow [not to benefit] from seafarers is permitted [to benefit] from those who live on dry land" - [This refers to people] who do not remain on the seashore, as they are not accustomed to cross the sea. However, a person who crosses once in a long while and is not accustomed to cross there is not called [one of the] "seafarers," and one who takes a vow [not to benefit] from seafarers is permitted [to benefit] from him. And even according to the one who says in the Gemara that those who travel from Akko to Jaffa are called "seafarers" — there, although they do not tarry in it [at sea], nevertheless they are accustomed to cross regularly, [being] frequent crossers of the sea; but this person who crosses once in ten years is not called [one of the] "seafarers" at all, for in vows one follows the common parlance of people.

Tosafot on Nedarim 30a:4:2.english: Not like those who go from Akko to Jaffa - In the Gemara, [it] explains to what [this] refers:

Tosafot on Nedarim 30a:4:3.english: But rather one who customarily departs - [That is,] to be [at sea] for many days at a time.
